summary: An 8-crate Rust decentralized exchange workspace (`matching-engine`, `commitments`, `front-running`, `homomorphic-compare`, `bft`, `node`, `api-server`, `tests`) implementing threshold cryptography, Shamir's Secret Sharing order fragmentation, Pedersen commitments, and PBFT validator consensus.

tasks.title: Harden secure multiparty comparison protocol for private limit order matching
tasks.spec:
Upgrade `crates/homomorphic-compare` so that evaluating `bid_price >= ask_price` across secret-shared orders executes via a verified 2-party/3-party comparison protocol (e.g. DGK or Beaver-triple bit-decomposition) without reconstructing the plain prices.

1. Output only a 1-bit encrypted share indicating whether a trade crossed.
2. Add unit tests proving that order books match correctly at the exact market clearing price while individual order prices remain hidden from all participating nodes.

tasks.title: Enforce cryptographic commit-reveal timelocks and mempool anti-front-running invariants
tasks.spec:
Strengthen `crates/front-running/src/commit_reveal.rs` so that orders must be committed as $C = \text{Pedersen}(P, Q, r)$ within epoch $T$.

1. The mempool must reject any reveal phase message submitted before the commit phase has closed and been locked by a PBFT block header.
2. Reject any reveal whose commitment opening fails or whose timestamp exceeds the reveal deadline.
3. Add unit tests for front-running insertion attempts and late reveal cancellations.

tasks.title: Enforce strict conservation of asset balances in matching-engine settlement
tasks.spec:
Ensure `crates/matching-engine/src/engine.rs` enforces exact integer conservation: for every matched fill of base quantity $Q$ at price $P$, buyer base asset balance increases by $Q - \text{fee}_{\text{base}}$, seller quote asset balance increases by $(Q \cdot P) - \text{fee}_{\text{quote}}$, and the sum of all balances plus exchange fee vault equals the pre-trade total exactly.

1. Add unit and fuzz tests verifying zero underflow or balance drift.
